description: This file contains shell script code for testing bounds-checking of access to mmapped on-disk file formats in Git, including setup, manipulation, and verification of pack files and index files with various error conditions.

methods.name: clear_base
methods.description: Removes the base pack files and restores the environment after tests.

methods.name: restore_base
methods.description: Restores the original pack files from backup.

methods.name: do_pack
methods.description: Creates a pack file from specified objects.

methods.name: munge
methods.description: Corrupts or modifies pack/index files at specific offsets.

methods.name: ofs_table
methods.description: Calculates offset in index for initial offset table.

methods.name: extended_table
methods.description: Calculates offset for extended offset table in index.
